In summary, our research is concerned with
histological changes of digestive system and its associated glands of silver pomfet larva from the first day after hatching to the 12 th day after hatching.
the development of digestive system of silver pomfert larva,which is of great significance to the artificial breeding of silver pomfrett and the study on the nutrition of silver pomfett larvae.

the histological changes in digestive system during larval development of silver pomfert,and provides some basic data for further studies on the development of digestive system of silver pomfet and its nutrition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, the digestive system and associated gland of silver pomfert developed gradually during 12 days after hatching,and the development was not synchronous.The digestive tract developed faster than the gland,which indicated that the digestive tract was the main part of digestive system,and the gland was the assistant of digestive tract.

, the digestive tract of silver pomfert larva developed rapidly from the first day after hatching to the 12 day after hatching,and the digestive tract and associated glands of 12 day larva had the capacity of digest and absorb nutrition to some extent.
the digestive system of silver pomfert larva was well developed from 3rd to 12th days after hatching, and the ability to intake and digest food was gradually improved.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

silver pomfret larvae had a straight diverticulums at the first day after hatching,and it was differentiated into esophagus,stamach,intestine and pyloric caecum on the 3th day,and the esophageal sac had the rudiment on the 5th day.The esophageal sac of silver pomfert larva could mill food on the 12th after hatching,but it could not vermiculate well.
the digestive tract developed gradually from 3 day old silver pomffret larva,with the development of digestive tract and associated glands,so did the ability to digest and absorb food.

the development of digestive system is an important factor for silver pomfret larvae to survive and grow well,and the development of digestive tract is closely related to the development of associated glands and the development of digestive ability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
